ruling.note: Owner's ruling (2026-11-12): 241219BRY is pooled 3' prime-seq (owner's ruling 2026-10-27, see expression-two-groups). 3' reads do not cover the HLA class I exons, so refusing to build hlatyping is correct. The 2026-10-26 migrated ruling, which expected an hlatyping build, predates the pool ruling. The story now expects a reasoned refusal and no launch.

stories.question: Which HLA alleles does this donor carry?

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own sequenced samples.
why.pipelines: 241219BRY is pooled 3' prime-seq (SOP 65): barcoded oligo(dT) libraries read from the 3' end, one read only barcode and UMI. These reads do not cover the HLA class I exons, so hlatyping cannot resolve the donor's alleles from them. The right reply refuses with that reason, may say which reads would work (WES, WGS or full-length RNA-seq), and builds nothing.

stories.question: What are the HLA-A, HLA-B and HLA-C types of the donors in these genome samples?

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own sequenced samples.
why.pipelines: Human whole-genome germline DNA: the reads cover the HLA class I exons, so hlatyping (seq_type dna) calls each donor's HLA-A, -B and -C alleles. sarek calls variants, not HLA alleles; rnavar needs RNA.

ruling.note: Proposed to keep hlatyping at the four-story floor after the pooled prime-seq HLA stories became refusals; awaits the owner's ruling

stories.question: Can you get each donor's HLA class I genotype from my exome samples?

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own sequenced samples.
why.pipelines: Human whole-exome with a named capture kit (Agilent SureSelect Human All Exon V7): the capture covers the HLA class I exons, so hlatyping (seq_type dna) calls the alleles. sarek calls variants, not HLA alleles; rnavar needs RNA.

ruling.note: Proposed to keep hlatyping at the four-story floor after the pooled prime-seq HLA stories became refusals; awaits the owner's ruling

stories.question: Which HLA class I alleles does this breast cancer line carry, going by my RNA-seq samples?

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own sequenced samples.
why.pipelines: Human bulk paired-end full-length RNA-seq of MDA-MB-231 cells, with raw reads on SRA: the expressed HLA class I transcripts are covered end to end, so hlatyping (seq_type rna) calls the alleles. Contrast with the 241219BRY HLA stories, whose pooled 3' prime-seq reads do not cover those exons. rnaseq counts genes, rnavar calls variants and rnafusion calls fusions; none types HLA.
